title: OPK Hub Index
description: Schema for index.json, the entry document of an OES hub: a set of static files, served over HTTPS, that lists packages any consumer can browse and import. Open Package Format (OPK), version 0.2.0.

$schema.description: Optional editor/tooling hint. Ignored by parsers.

kind.description: Identifies this document as a hub index.

hub.description: Describes the hub itself, for display.

homepage.description: A human-readable page for the hub. Relative to index.json, or absolute.

moved_to.description: Set when the hub has relocated: the absolute URL of its new index.json. Static hosts can't redirect a JSON file, so a consumer MUST follow this field and SHOULD update the hub URL it has stored.

packages.description: One entry per package with at least one version that is not yanked. Order carries no meaning.

package_summary.description: Enough about a package to list and search it; everything else is in its hub package document.

name.description: {namespace}/{package}, both kebab-case. The namespace is what a registry grants ownership of; OPK takes no position on how.

entry_type.description: The type of the package's entry document.

latest.description: The highest version that is not yanked.

url.description: The package's hub package document. Relative to index.json, or absolute.
